objectives.definition: eligible measured cells with organic local-pack rank 1-3 / all valid measured cells
objectives.minimum_evidence: Identical grid, query set, device/language, provider and collection method at baseline and comparison; record unavailable/blocked cells rather than ranking them.

objectives.definition: consented analytics sessions attributed to organic search and city/region in the declared market
objectives.minimum_evidence: GA4 or approved analytics export with unchanged filters and documented consent/thresholding.

objectives.definition: unique, non-test inquiries meeting documented fit criteria and containing consented local context, deduplicated by CRM lead ID
objectives.minimum_evidence: CRM disposition plus first-touch and last-touch UTM/source; no inferred location from sensitive data.

objectives.definition: distinct, editorially valid local media, organization, event, or partner pages mentioning ClearGlassInc Artemis
objectives.minimum_evidence: Canonical URL, publication date, capture timestamp, and manual relevance review; exclude self-published and paid placements unless separately labelled.

stop_conditions: complaint-rate threshold set by compliance is exceeded
